title: US Officials Crack Down on AI-Powered Student Loan Fraud
subtitle: Federal authorities have charged five people in a major investigation into criminals using stolen identities and artificial intelligence to steal millions in taxpayer money.

summary.en: The United States Department of Justice has charged five individuals for a large-scale student loan fraud scheme. Criminals used stolen identities of Americans to pose as college students and collect federal financial aid. The group used artificial intelligence to complete coursework and manage the fraudulent applications. Officials seized over $750,000 in cryptocurrency linked to the network. The government has promised to continue its investigation into these international fraud operations.
summary.zh: 美國司法部起訴五名涉及大規模學生貸款詐騙案的人士。罪犯利用竊取的美國民眾身分假冒大學生，藉此領取聯邦財務補助。該集團利用人工智慧完成課程作業並管理詐騙申請。官員已查扣超過七十五萬美元與該網絡相關的加密貨幣。政府承諾將持續調查這些國際詐騙行動。

paragraphs.en: In a major move against financial crime, the United States Department of Justice (DOJ) has announced charges against five people involved in a massive fraud scheme. This operation targeted federal student loan programs by using artificial intelligence (AI) to pretend to be real students. This development follows recent reports that authorities were investigating a large network of so-called “ghost students”—fake identities used to steal money meant for education.
paragraphs.zh: 為了打擊金融犯罪，美國司法部（Department of Justice）採取重大行動，宣布起訴五名涉及大規模詐騙案的人士。此行動針對聯邦學生貸款計畫，詐騙集團利用人工智慧（AI）假冒真實學生身分。在此之前，已有報導指出當局正在調查一個龐大的「幽靈學生」網絡，這些虛假身分被用來竊取原本用於教育的資金。

paragraphs.en: According to Ars Technica, the DOJ explained that the criminals first bought private information belonging to Americans. They specifically looked for high school graduates who had never attended college. By using this sensitive data, the fraudsters were able to complete the Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA). Once they were accepted into universities or community colleges, the government sent money to the schools to pay for tuition. Any extra money that remained was then sent to bank accounts controlled by the criminals.
paragraphs.zh: 根據科技新聞網站 Ars Technica 報導，司法部說明這些罪犯首先購買了美國民眾的私人資訊，特別鎖定那些從未就讀大學的高中畢業生。詐騙者利用這些敏感資料填寫聯邦學生援助免費申請表（FAFSA）。一旦被大學或社區學院錄取，政府便會撥款給學校支付學費，而剩餘的款項則會匯入由罪犯控制的銀行帳戶。

paragraphs.en: Artificial intelligence played a key role in this scheme. The fraudsters used AI tools to complete the required college coursework, making the fake students appear legitimate to school officials. This allowed the criminals to keep the accounts active and continue collecting money. The DOJ noted that the scheme relied on a network of people, including some who acted as “money mules”—individuals who help move stolen money for others—to receive the funds in their own bank accounts.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智慧在此計畫中扮演關鍵角色。詐騙者利用人工智慧工具完成必要的課程作業，使這些虛假學生在校方眼中看起來像是真實就讀。這讓罪犯得以維持帳戶活躍並持續領取資金。司法部指出，該計畫依賴一個人員網絡，其中包括擔任「洗錢車手」的人員，這些人協助將贓款轉移至自己的銀行帳戶中。

paragraphs.en: This investigation has led to the first international seizure of its kind in Kenya. Officials successfully took control of more than $750,000 in cryptocurrency, which is a type of digital money that is often hard to track. Assistant Attorney General Colin M. McDonald, who works for the National Fraud Enforcement Division, said the arrests were made possible by new fraud-detection measures recently put in place by the Trump administration. He warned that this is only the beginning of a larger effort to stop these crimes.
paragraphs.zh: 這項調查促成了在肯亞進行的首次同類型國際扣押行動。官員成功查扣超過七十五萬美元的加密貨幣，這是一種通常難以追蹤的數位貨幣。隸屬於國家詐欺執法部門的助理司法部長麥克唐納（Colin M. McDonald）表示，這些逮捕行動歸功於川普政府近期實施的新型詐欺偵測措施。他警告，這僅是遏止此類犯罪更大規模行動的開端。

paragraphs.en: “If you steal American identities, if you steal taxpayer dollars, if you exploit programs meant to help students build a future—we will find you,” McDonald stated during a press conference. He added that the government would pursue these criminals no matter where they are located, whether in the United States or abroad in places like Nairobi. The FBI and the Department of Education are working together to identify more people involved in this network.
paragraphs.zh: 麥克唐納在記者會上表示：「如果你竊取美國人的身分、竊取納稅人的錢，或是濫用旨在幫助學生建立未來的計畫，我們一定會找到你。」他補充說，無論罪犯身在何處，無論是在美國境內還是像奈洛比（Nairobi）這樣的海外地點，政府都將追緝到底。聯邦調查局（FBI）與教育部正攜手合作，以辨識更多參與此網絡的人員。

paragraphs.en: This case highlights the growing risks of using AI for illegal activities. While AI can be a helpful tool for learning, it is also being used by bad actors to automate complex fraud. By using technology to handle the work of hundreds of students at once, the criminals were able to steal millions of dollars from the federal government. This has created a difficult challenge for schools and government agencies, which must now find better ways to verify the identity of every student applying for aid.
paragraphs.zh: 此案凸顯了利用人工智慧進行非法活動日益增加的風險。雖然人工智慧是學習的實用工具，但也被不法分子用來自動化執行複雜的詐騙手段。透過技術同時處理數百名學生的作業，罪犯得以從聯邦政府手中竊取數百萬美元。這對學校與政府機關造成了嚴峻挑戰，現在必須尋求更好的方法來驗證每位申請補助學生的身分。

paragraphs.en: For many Americans, this news is a reminder of how important it is to protect personal information. The fraudsters relied on the fact that many people do not realize their data has been stolen until it is already being used to commit a crime. The DOJ is now focusing on how to stop these applications before the money is ever sent out. As the investigation continues, officials expect to find more connections between the individuals charged and other international groups.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多美國人而言，這則新聞提醒了保護個人資訊的重要性。詐騙者利用了許多民眾在資料被盜用前並未察覺的漏洞。司法部目前正致力於如何在撥款前攔截這些申請。隨著調查持續進行，官員預計將發現被起訴者與其他國際組織之間更多的關聯。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the government has made it clear that they are not stopping with these five arrests. The success of this operation serves as a warning to others who might try to use similar methods to cheat the system. As technology continues to change, the methods used by criminals will likely become more advanced, meaning that federal agencies will need to keep updating their own systems to stay one step ahead. For now, the focus remains on catching those responsible for stealing funds that were intended to help students achieve their dreams of higher education.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，政府已明確表示不會僅止於這五次逮捕行動。此次行動的成功對其他試圖利用類似手法欺騙體系的人發出了警告。隨著科技持續演變，罪犯使用的方法可能會變得更加先進，這意味著聯邦機構必須持續更新自身系統，以保持領先。目前，重點仍放在逮捕那些竊取旨在幫助學生實現高等教育夢想資金的相關人士。

previousArticles.title: US Officials Uncover Massive Student Loan Fraud Scheme Using AI
previousArticles.summaryEn: The United States Department of Justice has charged five people for running a large-scale student loan fraud scheme. These individuals used stolen identities to pose as college students and collect federal financial aid. The criminals utilized artificial intelligence to complete coursework and bypass security measures. Authorities seized over $750,000 in cryptocurrency during the investigation. Officials warn that this is only the beginning of a broader effort to stop international identity theft.

quiz.question: What specific criterion did the fraudsters use to select the identities of the individuals they targeted?

options.A: They targeted students who were currently enrolled in community colleges.
options.B: They looked for high school graduates who had never attended a college.
options.C: They chose individuals who had previously applied for federal student aid.
options.D: They selected people who had recently moved to Kenya.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，詐騙者明確尋找的是「high school graduates who had never attended college」（高中畢業但從未上過大學的人）。選項 A 錯誤，因為他們偽造的是未入學的身分；選項 C 錯誤，因為文章提到他們是用這些資料去申請 FAFSA，而非找已經申請過的人；選項 D 則是混淆了詐騙者的所在地與受害者的身分特徵。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why did the criminals need to use AI to complete college coursework?

options.A: To create new, fake identities for the criminals themselves.
options.B: To bypass the security measures of the Kenyan government.
options.C: To maintain the illusion of being real students so the funding would continue.
options.D: To increase the amount of money they could receive from the bank.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章第三段提到，詐騙者使用 AI 完成課業是為了讓這些虛假學生在學校官員眼中看起來「合法（legitimate）」，進而讓帳戶保持活躍並持續領取政府補助。選項 A 錯誤，身分是從高畢業生那買來的；選項 B 錯誤，AI 是為了應付學校而非肯亞政府；選項 D 錯誤，AI 的功能是維持帳戶運作，而非直接增加補助金額。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'stay one step ahead' mean in the context of the government's strategy?

options.A: To anticipate and prevent the evolving methods of criminals.
options.B: To walk faster than the criminals when making arrests.
options.C: To prioritize catching the leaders of the network first.
options.D: To ensure that all students receive their aid before the deadline.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。片語「stay one step ahead」意指「領先一步」，在文中用來描述政府必須不斷更新系統，以應對罪犯日益進步的犯罪手法。選項 B 是字面上的誤解，與犯罪偵查無關；選項 C 雖然政府確實想抓首腦，但這並非該片語在此處的意涵；選項 D 與文章強調的防範詐騙主題不符。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of this article regarding the recent DOJ investigation?

options.A: The US government is focusing exclusively on recovering cryptocurrency from Kenya.
options.B: AI tools are now the only way for students to successfully apply for financial aid.
options.C: The government is struggling to find ways to protect student identities from hackers.
options.D: The DOJ is combating a sophisticated fraud scheme that exploits AI and stolen identities to steal federal education funds.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。這篇文章的核心在於報導司法部如何打擊一項利用 AI 與竊取個資來詐領聯邦教育資金的計畫。選項 A 太過狹隘，僅提到追回資金；選項 B 完全錯誤，文章並未說 AI 是申請補助的必要工具；選項 C 雖然提到挑戰，但並非文章的主旨，文章強調的是政府正在採取行動並警告犯罪者。
